description:
## Why

Per PKIX-amgn.8 decisions (2026-05-11): the maintainer-only 'run zlint -listLintsJSON, transform to OSCAL Catalog JSON, write vendored output' tool lives as a Rust dev-only sub-crate in the workspace. publish=false. Reuses OSCAL types from pkix-lint at compile time; avoids JSON-transform duplication.

## What

1. Add new workspace member: `pkix-lint-cabf-refresh` under workspace root.
2. Cargo.toml:
   - `publish = false`
   - `rust-version` matches workspace MSRV
   - Binary target (default), no library
   - Deps:
     - `serde = { workspace = true, features = ["derive"] }`
     - `serde_json = { workspace = true }`
     - `pkix-lint = { workspace = true, features = ["oscal"] }` (for OSCAL types if needed)
     - `clap = { workspace = true, features = ["derive"] }` (CLI args; or anyhow + simpler args, TBD by impl)
3. src/main.rs stub:
   - Parses CLI args: --zlint-output <path>, --output-dir <path>, --zlint-sha <sha>
   - Currently prints args and exits 0 (transform logic lands in PKIX-amgn.8.3)
4. README.md at crate root describing the maintainer workflow.
5. Workspace Cargo.toml: add `pkix-lint-cabf-refresh` to members list.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `cargo check -p pkix-lint-cabf-refresh` clean.
- [ ] `cargo run -p pkix-lint-cabf-refresh -- --help` shows CLI usage.
- [ ] Workspace publish-check (`cargo publish --dry-run -p <crate>`) skips this crate due to publish=false.
- [ ] No source code transforms yet (PKIX-amgn.8.3 does that).

## Out of scope

- Implementing the zlint JSON -> OSCAL Catalog transform (PKIX-amgn.8.3).
- Vendoring the first catalog output (PKIX-amgn.8.4).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.8.1 (local zlint setup — for end-to-end smoke test of the stub).

## Filed by

Decomposed from PKIX-amgn.8 per Mark's 2026-05-11 decisions.
title: Create pkix-lint-cabf-refresh dev-only sub-crate skeleton
